LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
ACT III OF 1998
An Act further to
amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary,
8th May, 1998]
No. PAP-Legis.-2(16)/97/33,
dated 8-5-1998.---The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1997,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on April 17, 1998,
and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on May 4, 1998, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Lahore Development
Authority (Amendment) Act, 1998
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4-A of Act XXX of 1975

ACT III OF 1998
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
ACT III OF 1998
An Act further to
amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary,
8th May, 1998]
No. PAP-Legis.-2(16)/97/33,
dated 8-5-1998.---The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1997,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on April 17, 1998,
and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on May 4, 1998, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Amendment of section 4-A of
Act XXX of 1975.---In the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 (XXX of
1975) hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for section 4-A the following
shall be substituted:---
"4-A. Vice
Chairman.--(1) The Government may designate from amongst the members not
more than two Vice-Chairmen of the Authority.
(2) A Vice-Chairman shall perform
such functions as may be assigned to him by the Authority. "

Amendment of section 7 of Act XXX of 1975

ACT III OF 1998
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1998
ACT III OF 1998
An Act further to
amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary,
8th May, 1998]
No. PAP-Legis.-2(16)/97/33,
dated 8-5-1998.---The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1997,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on April 17, 1998,
and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on May 4, 1998, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
3. Amendment of section 7 of
Act XXX of 1975.--In the said Act, in section 7, for subsection (2) the
following shall be substituted:--
"(2) The meetings of the
Authority shall be presided over by --
(i) the Chairman;
(ii) in the absence of the
Chairman the Vice-Chairman;
(iii) in case there are more than
one Vice-Chairmen, in accordance with such priority as may be determined by the
Authority; and
(iv) in the absence of the
Chairman as well as the Vice-Chairman by a Member of the Authority elected for
the purpose by the Members present, from amongst themselves. "
Repeal.--The Lahore
Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance,. 1998 (V of 1998) is hereby
repealed.
